en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a large Gothic-style cathedral, prominently displaying ornate spires and intricate stonework. The view is from an elevated vantage point, looking toward the elaborate crossing tower of the cathedral. The cityscape of Burgos is visible in the background. The text on the postcard indicates the location and subject of the image.
